answers.core: afaik there are no straightforward ways to set and load Shortcuts
answers.workaround:
no.
It seems the shortcuts are stored in `editor_settings-4.tres` but it also has other editor settings. I believe shortcuts should be in a separate file. Then you are able to change this file "manually", but I think doing it from Godot Editor would be more convenient.

title: Add an ability to save and load Editor Shortcuts
